\opt{D}{Charge densities on both the halves of a sphere are equal.}
\end{qoptions}
\end{bankq}

Thickness of the slab is d and relative permittivity is $\varepsilon_\text{r}$. If your answer is V = $\sqrt{\dfrac{\text{x}\sigma\text{d}}{\varepsilon_\text{r}\varepsilon_0}}$ write value of x.
\end{bankq}

(IV) & Ratio of electrostatic potential energy stored between the plates of capacitor A and between the plates of capacitor B as function of time. & (S) & $\dfrac{\text{QV}}{\text{d}}$\\ \hline
 & & (T) & increases\\ \hline
\end{tabular}}\par
\begin{qoptions}

\opt{C}{I $\to$ Q,T;II $\to$ S;III $\to$ P,R;IV $\to$ Q}
